title: inspect
description: The inspector's own state, in a page's own graph: never synced, gone with the page.

map.description: the inspector's map: the listings it shows under its query bar, in order; what is typed in the bar is the same entity's `filter` (@yaks/filter)

listings.description: the eids of its listings, in the order they show

listing.description: one listing on the inspector's map: a saved query, drawn as its rows

query.description: the saved query its rows are

of.description: what its rows are, which says how they are drawn and what else is asked beside them

open.description: its rows are shown, not folded away

limit.description: how many rows it shows before saying how many more there are

section.description: one section of an inspector page, open or folded; its id is the page's entity and the section's view, `<eid> <view>`

open.description: its body is shown and its queries asked

said.description: why the graph refused its last write, until the next one lands

lens.description: how an entity's inspector page shows it; its id is the entity's

view.description: the view its body is drawn as: `Inspect.Sections` (its parts, section by section) or another the registry offers it (`Inspect.JSON`)

armed.description: deleting it was pressed once, and a second press deletes it

trail.description: the way the inspector came to what it shows: the entities drilled through, oldest first

steps.description: the eids of the pages visited, the last one the page shown
